title: Choose the visual world for agency-of-one.dev
question: The roll assigned The Prompt Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Whichever you pick, scrolling drives one product being built, ending in email + LinkedIn + kevinkrs.com.

options.label: The Prompt Book
options.lineage: theatre: front of house, backstage and the stage manager's cue stack
options.thesis: The visitor watches a simple product on stage; scrolling flies the set away and shows the one person running every cue behind it.
options.viewport: A full-width proscenium in oxblood: a small product screen plays on stage, the headline sits on the valance, a cue stack runs down the right wing with cue 1 standing by, and the contact action is a door plaque top right.
options.risk: The metaphor sits between a CTO and the real mechanism, so every cue has to name a real technical event.

raised.raise: Every cue that has run stays visible in the stack, so the page ends as a full record of what the build took.
The cue stack is a fixed grid: rows change state in place and never move.
One continuous scene from curtain to fly loft, with no section cuts.

options.label: The Section
options.lineage: architectural section drawings with a travelling sunbeam
options.thesis: The product is a building cut open: the shopfront is the interface, the floors below are server, auth, cloud and ML, and a request travels down as a beam of light.
options.viewport: One long section drawing: the street-level shopfront holds the headline and a working app screen, the ground line cuts the page at 60%, and the first basement floor shows below it. The contact action is the plaque on the door.
options.case: Shows the hidden part of a product at one glance, which is the core message. It also matches my own top-ranked idea, so there is no separate pick card.
options.risk: A drawing can read calm and static; the travelling beam has to carry all the energy.

options.label: Elbow Console
options.thesis: Each layer of the stack is a flat colour bank on black, and scrolling sweeps the elbow frame from bank to bank as systems come online.
options.viewport: A thick lilac elbow frames the viewport with the headline in condensed caps inside it; a pill column on the left lists the layers with only WIREFRAME lit in gold.
options.case: Tech teams identify with it at once; it loses on clarity for non-technical solo entrepreneurs.
options.risk: Reads as a sci-fi fan homage and can put a costume over the message.

options.label: The Build Train
options.lineage: Constructivist poster trains: diagonals, stencil type, one red wedge
options.thesis: Each railcar is one stage of the build, and a red wedge drives the request from car to car as you scroll sideways.
options.viewport: The first car fills the viewport on a diagonal with the stencil headline; the red wedge enters from the left and points at the edge of the next car.
options.case: Car by car is the clearest linear pipeline; it loses on identification for a consultant's audience.
options.risk: Cream, black and red is where many generated pages land, and the poster tone can feel loud for a one-person business.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: The product rises course by course.
options.viewport: A tower section with the current course marked dark.
options.case: Craft and clay say nothing about software to this audience.
options.kept: Everything built stays visible as a record.

options.label: Shader Portal
options.thesis: A living shader with thin type over it.
options.viewport: One hero word over a breathing field.
options.case: A mood, not a mechanism: it hides the offer and shows no build.
options.kept: One continuous scene instead of stacked sections.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Every moving part of a product as a row on one board.
options.viewport: A full board of rows flipping into place.
options.case: Lists complexity but cannot illustrate a flow through it.
options.kept: A fixed grid where state changes in place.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer-tool landing page: a dark ground, a node diagram that animates as you scroll, executed at the level of linear.app and railway.com.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline and action over a live architecture diagram.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every developer-tool site by design.
